why.founding: A river port ESE of the Hatching Pools, grown into a town by being neutral about cargo. It sits on the northern trunk between Stormhold and Thorn, on water deep enough for a laden hull and far enough from either customs regime that both of them use it.
why.siteAdvantages: The last reach of navigable river below the northern rim, with an oxbow that makes a natural basin, firm banks for warehousing and a rim road behind it that crosses to Morrowind without passing a post.
why.occupantsMotive: A captain of the port who governs by a nailed-up price list, freeholder crews with no tribe and no tree, Dunmer factors from the Morrowind trade and Nord hands off the northern hulls.
why.pressures: There is no Hist here. What holds a crew to the town is the price list and the depth of water. Stormhold's vicecanons would like the trade but cannot reach it. Rockpoint downriver failed trying to undercut the list.
why.wouldChangeIf: If either Stormhold or Thorn made the port lawful, the trade would move elsewhere. If the river silted below the oxbow, the town would be a village in five years.
